name: Rakuen e no Athanasia ~Otoko no Ko Maid to Sannin no Himegimi, Inbi Naru Kairaku to Tousaku no Sono~
original_name: 楽園へのアタナシア　～男の娘メイドと三人の姫君、淫靡なる快楽と倒錯の園～
source:
The beautiful boy in a maid's dress is flanked by the perverted love of three princesses. 
Set in a fantasy version of Middle Ages Europe in the fictional kingdom of Baoto. 

Three beautiful princesses compete for the love of a young man in drag. 

[edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166604.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
身穿女仆装的美少年，被三位公主扭曲而淫乱的爱意包围。

故事发生在虚构的巴奥托王国，一个中世纪欧洲风格的幻想国度。

三位美丽公主争夺女装美少年的爱情。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE166604.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
